# The Ronin's Rescue — Wind-Up and Reaction

Robbers attack the Shogun's daughter in a cedar forest; she fights back, and a ronin drives the robber leader off. Every strike is shown as a wind-up and a reaction, cut at the moment of contact.

## Characters
- "the woman in grey": a young East Asian woman with fair skin, long black hair pinned up with three jade hairpins, wearing a pale grey silk kimono with a silver obi.
- "the ronin": a lean man in his late thirties with a topknot and a scarred brow, wearing a faded indigo haori and dark hakama.
- "robber leader": a broad-shouldered man in his forties with a black beard, wearing a tattered brown haori and a leather sash.

## Panel 1 — The Wind-Up
Image: A medium shot of the "robber leader": a broad-shouldered man in his forties with a black beard, wearing a tattered brown haori and a leather sash. He stands on the left of the frame in a wide fighting stance, facing right, gripping a short sword in both hands at shoulder height, his face twisted in a snarl. The setting is a dense cedar forest in feudal Japan, tall trunks and ferns behind him, the ground covered in leaf litter. The lighting is a flat, overcast grey afternoon. The camera is at chest height, slightly to his right. Rendered as a photorealistic live-action film still.
Motion: The robber leader raises his short sword high above his head, his whole body tensing to strike. The camera stays static.
Narration: The robber leader lifts his blade.

## Panel 2 — She Recoils
Image: A medium close-up of "the woman in grey": a young East Asian woman with fair skin, long black hair pinned up with three jade hairpins, wearing a pale grey silk kimono with a silver obi. She stands on the right of the frame, facing left toward an attacker just outside the frame, her eyes wide with fear, her right hand rising toward her face. The setting is a dense cedar forest in feudal Japan, tall trunks and ferns behind her, the ground covered in leaf litter. The lighting is a flat, overcast grey afternoon. The camera is at eye level, slightly to her left. Rendered as a photorealistic live-action film still.
Motion: The woman in grey flinches backward, throwing her arm up to shield her face. The camera stays static.
Narration: She throws up her arm as the blade comes down.

Image: A medium shot of the "robber leader": a broad-shouldered man in his forties with a black beard, wearing a tattered brown haori and a leather sash. Image: A medium shot of "the ronin": a lean man in his late thirties with a topknot and a scarred brow, wearing a faded indigo haori and dark hakama. ## Panel 6 — The Robber Falls
Image: A medium shot of the "robber leader": a broad-shouldered man in his forties with a black beard, wearing a tattered brown haori and a leather sash. He is on the left of the frame, facing right, knocked off balance and leaning far backward, arms flung out, his short sword slipping from his hand. The setting is a dense cedar forest in feudal Japan, tall trunks and ferns behind him, the ground covered in leaf litter. The lighting is a flat, overcast grey afternoon.
